data.title: Senior Copy / Concept (m/f/d)
data.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Copy / Concept (m/f/d) to join our Creative team, preferably based in Munich. The role is initially fixed-term for 18 months.

We are a global, socially-led creative agency with more than 1,300 people across 17 offices worldwide. In a world where social media shapes culture, we help brands create ideas worth talking about.

We understand online communities, cultures and subcultures across the entire social landscape. Our clients in Germany include AUDI AG, Mercedes-Benz Trucks and Müller, among others. We Are Social is part of Plus Company.

Requirements

What will you be doing?

  • Developing social-first concepts and creative ideas, from big campaigns to individual social posts
  • Shaping distinctive tones of voice and verbal identities for our clients
  • Writing excellent, native-level English copy across brands, formats and social platforms
  • Turning strategies and briefs into strong creative and verbal concepts
  • Presenting and championing creative ideas with clients
  • Working closely with Design, Strategy and Editorial while taking creative ownership of your projects

What are we looking for?

  • Several years of experience in copywriting and concept development, ideally within an agency
  • A strong copy background with conceptual experience or vice versa
  • Native or excellent English and an exceptional feel for language, tone of voice and storytelling
  • Experience developing brand tones of voice and verbal identities
  • A strong understanding of social media, platform culture and contemporary brand communication
  • The ability to deliver both big ideas and sharp social copy
  • Experience with automotive, German industrial companies or international brands is a plus

Benefits

Why should you join our team?

Our team spirit: We put the social in our name for a reason. We foster a strong sense of team and an open company culture with flat hierarchies, where your voice matters!

Exciting projects with international reach: We work on digital projects that set new standards! Our clients come from both B2C and B2B backgrounds and include local as well as international players.

Globally connected, locally rooted: Our teams in Munich and Kreuzberg benefit from continuous knowledge sharing with We Are Social offices around the world, while being firmly rooted in Munich’s Glockenbachviertel and Berlin-Kreuzberg.

Flexibility – yes, please!: For us, hybrid working combines the best of both worlds: the flexibility of working from home and the benefits of spending time together in the office. That’s why we’ve chosen a 2/3 split. For a 40-hour working week, this means spending at least 2 days on-site with your colleagues and up to 3 days working from home. But that’s not all! We’re also big fans of remote working. You can work remotely for up to 20 days per year from anywhere in Germany, plus another 20 days from within Europe. So, if you’re not a big fan of the German winter, join us and spend some of it working from Portugal or Greece.

Even more benefits for you: Because we know how important well-being is – and because we simply love a good benefit – we offer more than just the standard package. Enjoy 2 additional Health Days, Menstrual Leave, a day off on your birthday, access to Wellpass, the Deutschlandticket, an OpenUp membership, and much more.

data.title: Lead Frontend Developer (m/f/d) – Angular / TypeScript
data.description:
Do you want to shape the frontend of software that makes industrial energy systems smarter and more sustainable?

At etalytics, we develop AI-powered energy management solutions that help industrial companies reduce energy consumption, CO₂ emissions, and operating costs. Our etaONE® Energy Intelligence Platform combines IoT, data analytics, and artificial intelligence to turn complex energy data into actionable insights.

As our Lead Frontend Developer, you will take technical leadership of our frontend team and combine hands-on development with architectural responsibility and team coordination. You will work closely with UX/UI, Product Management, and Backend, establish strong technical standards, and help shape the long-term frontend strategy of our platform.

Tasks

  • Take technical leadership of the frontend team while remaining hands-on, with approximately 30–50% of your role focused on coding.

  • Drive the frontend architecture of our etaONE® platform and build scalable, maintainable solutions with Angular and TypeScript.

  • Collaborate closely with UX/UI, Product Management, and Backend to turn product requirements into robust, user-friendly features.

  • Define and continuously improve frontend standards, including coding guidelines, design systems, testing, and development practices.

  • Shape the long-term frontend strategy and evaluate new technologies, frameworks, and tools where they create real value.

  • Support the team through code reviews, technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and AI-supported development workflows.



  • You bring at least 4 years of professional frontend development experience with strong hands-on expertise in Angular and TypeScript.

  • Previous experience in technical leadership, team coordination, or mentoring enables you to guide developers while staying close to the code.

  • You have experience building and maintaining larger web applications or SPAs and are confident with modern frontend architecture and design patterns.

  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, CSS/SCSS, responsive design, testing, and software quality practices is part of your toolkit.

  • You are comfortable defining technical standards, conducting code reviews, and making pragmatic architectural decisions with long-term maintainability in mind.

  • Experience with modern Angular concepts and technologies such as NgRx, Signals, SignalStore, NX, TanStack Query, or data visualization libraries is an advantage.

  • You communicate confidently in English and work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Benefits:

Purpose-driven work: Support industrial companies in becoming more efficient and sustainable

Flexibility: Hybrid working with home office options and flexible working hours

Team spirit: A supportive, collaborative environment with plenty of room for exchange and cooperation

Community: Regular team events and shared activities

Work-life balance: 30 days of vacation plus a flexible, agile work culture

Well-being: Tax-free benefits card, subsidized local gym membership and the option of a job bike

Ready to make an impact?

Send us your CV (PDF) together with your earliest possible start date.

We can’t wait to meet you and shape the future of energy together!

data.title: Werkstudent im Bereich Carrier Management (m/w/d)
data.description:
Liebe*r Student*in

heute bewerben wir uns bei dir und stellen dir unser Unternehmen, unsere Leistungen und Besondere an Plusnet vor:

Wir leben und gestalten Kommunikation

Die Plusnet GmbH, eine Tochtergesellschaft der EnBW, ist ein deutsches Telekommunikationsunternehmen mit Fokus auf Geschäftskunden. Plusnet betreibt eine eigene, bundesweite Netzinfrastruktur und verfügt über jahrzehntelange Erfahrung im Betrieb unterschiedlicher Breitband-Technologien. Auf Basis ihres umfassenden Know-hows stellt die Plusnet Gruppe mehr als 40.000 Geschäftskunden jeder Größenordnung zuverlässige und hochsichere Sprach- und Datendienste zur Verfügung. Darüber hinaus agiert Plusnet als Vermittler zukunftssicherer Netze: Über die bundesweite offene Connectivity-Handelsplattform Netbridge können Partner eigene Glasfasernetze bzw. andere Infrastrukturen besser auslasten oder zusätzliche Reichweite für eigene Services gewinnen. Das Unternehmen mit Sitz in Köln beschäftigt rund 500 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter an insgesamt zehn deutschen Standorten.

Dein Wirkungsfeld

Als Werkstudent*in im Bereich Carrier Management hast du die Möglichkeit Teil eines tollen Teams zu sein, erste Erfahrungen im Lieferantenmanagement im Umfeld der deutschen Telekommunikationsunternehmen zu sammeln und einen wichtigen Beitrag zum unternehmerischen Erfolg von Plusnet zu leisten.



Dein Aufgabenfeld

  • Auswerten und übersichtliche Darstellung von Verträgen

  • Unterstützen von Onboarding Projekten inkl. Erstellen von Reportings

  • Prüfen von Rechnungen und Mitwirken beim Digitalisierungsprozess

  • Bestellen, Ändern und Kündigen von Datenleitungen bei unseren Vorlieferanten

  • Dokumentation und Qualitätssicherung der durchgeführten Tätigkeiten in den jeweiligen Systemen

Das bringst du mit

  • Du absolvierst aktuell ein Studium mit Bezug zu den Bereichen BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbaren Studiengängen

  • Du hast die Möglichkeit ca. 1 Mal pro Woche ins Büro (Köln Ossendorf) zu kommen

  • Du punktest durch dein offenes und kommunikatives Auftreten und bist motiviert, dein Engagement bei uns aktiv einzubringen

  • Dazu bringst du eine hohe Lernbereitschaft und Verbindlichkeit mit

  • Dich zeichnet eine verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise aus, auch bei wechselnden Aufgabenstellungen und neuen Herausforderungen

  • Du bringst sehr gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit dem MS-Office Paket mit

  • Du hast Spaß daran, mit Zahlen (im Rechnungsumfeld) zu arbeiten


Bei uns sind alle Menschen willkommen. Wir fördern Chancengleichheit unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Identität, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, mit oder ohne Behinderung.

Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, möchten wir dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, dich bei uns zu bewerben!

data.title: New Business Account Executive (DACH market)
data.description:
About The Role

Vivid Money is redefining how modern corporates, holding structures, and financial institutions manage and optimize their capital. From institutional-grade Treasury products (high-yield Interest Accounts, Money Market Funds, and ETFs) to multi-currency infrastructure and FX solutions, we provide the financial architecture that traditional banks make too slow and expensive.
We are expanding our institutional footprint in Germany.
We aren’t looking for a standard software sales rep; we are looking for a New Business Account Executive who understands the fabric of the German financial ecosystem. You will be employee number one on the ground, tasked with unlocking high-value segments: PE/VC funds, holding companies (Soparfis), family offices, and corporate service providers.
If you have the network to navigate corporate Germany, understand structured finance/treasury needs, and want the autonomy to build a market from scratch, this role is for you.


Your Mission

  • Originate Institutional Pipeline: Identify and engage decision-makers across Germanys unique B2B landscape, focusing on PE/VC funds, corporate holding structures, asset managers, and corporates.
  • Leverage Channel Partnerships: Build strategic relationships with local multipliers—accountants, tax advisors, law firms—who manage hundreds of entities requiring modern treasury setups.
  • Navigate Complex Sales Cycles: Run the end-to-end commercial cycle for high-value accounts, from sophisticated discovery and structured treasury pitches to compliance onboarding and closing.
  • Position Vivid as a Yield Partner: Educate fund managers and corporate treasurers on how to leverage Vivid’s Treasury and MMF solutions to optimize returns on their cash reserves and dry powder.
  • Shape the German Playbook: Partner directly with the Sales Leadership team to refine our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), localized messaging, and regulatory positioning for the German market.
  • Represent the Brand: Act as the face of Vivid Money GmbH at major financial services, fund industry, and fintech events in Germany.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years of B2B/Institutional sales experience within the German financial ecosystem (e.g., Private Banking, Corporate Banking, Fund Services, FinTech, or Treasury/Asset Management).
  • Deep local knowledge: You thoroughly understand Germanys financial structures (Soparfis, RAIFs, SICAVs) and know how these entities manage liquidity and banking relationships.
  • An established network: You have an existing book of contacts or a proven ability to network into CFOs, Fund Operations leads, Managing Directors, and Domiciliation Agents.
  • Technical fluency: You can speak confidently about FX, money market funds, yield generation, and compliance/KYB processes for complex corporate structures.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You thrive in an "AI-first," high-autonomy environment where the playbook is yours to write.
  • Languages: Full professional fluency in English and German is required. 


Why Join Vivid?

  • Hybrid or remote way of work. You can work from our Berlin office or fully remote from other locations. 
  • Direct influence on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth. 
  • Significant ownership from day one and strong growth opportunities. 
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.


Compensation range

Total target compensation: from €120,000 gross annually (base salary + performance-related bonus). Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

data.title: Senior Data Scientist (m/w/d) - Chemical Engineering & Verfahrenstechnik
data.description:
Startdatum

Wir suchen Dich ab sofort an einem unserer deutschen Standorte in München, Nürnberg, Leipzig, Berlin, Essen oder Frankfurt am Main!


Deine Aufgaben

Data und AI sind Dein zu Hause? Des Weiteren gestaltet sich Deine neue Herausforderung wie folgt:

  • Du verantwortest die Konzeption, Entwicklung und Implementierung moderner Data Science-, Machine Learning- und Generative AI-Lösungen für Kunden aus der Chemie-, Prozess- und Fertigungsindustrie
  • Du entwickelst skalierbare Machine Learning- und AI-Anwendungen - von Zeitreihenanalysen, Anomalieerkennung und Optimierungsverfahren bis hin zu LLM-, RAG- und Agentic-AI-Architekturen
  • Gemeinsam mit unseren Chemie- und Prozessexpert:innen analysierst Du komplexe Produktionsprozesse und übersetzt fachliche Fragestellungen in robuste, produktionsreife AI-Lösungen
  • Du verantwortest Deployment, Betrieb und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Lösungen auf modernen Cloud-Plattformen (Azure, AWS) sowie Databricks und etablierst MLOps- bzw. LLMOps-Standards
  • Du arbeitest interdisziplinär mit Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Data Engineers und Fachexpert:innen zusammen und begleitest unsere Kunden über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus
  • Als technische:r Ansprechpartner:in präsentierst Du Ergebnisse beim Kunden, unterstützt bei Architekturentscheidungen und entwickelst wieder verwendbare Frameworks, Assets und Best Practices für unsere Industrieprojekte


Dein Profil

Data ist auch in Deiner DNA? Das solltest Du mitbringen:

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (mindestens Master) im Bereich Chemieingenieurwesen, Verfahrenstechnik oder einer vergleichbaren ingenieur- bzw. naturwissenschaftlichen Fachrichtung mit Bezug zur Chemie- oder Prozessindustrie
  • Mehrjährige Vollzeit Berufserfahrung (mind. 2 Jahre) als Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer oder AI Engineer, idealerweise im Consulting- oder Projektumfeld

  • Alternativ bzw. ergänzend bringst Du praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Generative AI und Agentic AI mit - bspw. mit LLMs, RAG-Architekturen, Agentic Frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph oder AutoGen), Prompt Engineering sowie der Evaluierung und Optimierung produktiver AI-Systeme
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python sowie Erfahrung mit modernen Software-Engineering-Praktiken, APIs, Containerisierung (Docker/Kubernetes) und idealerweise MLOps bzw. LLMOps
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einer gängigen Cloud-Plattform (Azure oder AWS) sowie idealerweise mit Databricks
  • Du überzeugst durch ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, eine strukturierte und pragmatische Arbeitsweise sowie Freude daran, komplexe Kundenanforderungen eigenverantwortlich im Team zu lösen
  • Kommunikationsstärke sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen Dir eine souveräne Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und interdisziplinären Projektteams

data.title: Trainee Frontend Development (m/w/d)
data.description:
Du willst Frontend nicht nur lernen, sondern an echten Projekten anwenden. Bei uns baust du vom ersten Tag an mit, begleitet, aber nicht an der Seitenlinie. 

BRANDUNG ist eine unabhängige Digitalagentur in Berlin. Wir entwickeln Websites, Shops und Applikationen: für bekannte Marken ebenso wie für NGOs und gemeinnützige Organisationen. Gearbeitet wird in Teams aus Frontend, Backend, Design und Projektmanagement. Als Trainee arbeitest du in genau diesen Teams mit, mit einem festen Mentor oder einer festen Mentorin aus dem Frontend-Team an deiner Seite.


Dein Spielfeld

Was dich erwartet

  • Ein 12-monatiges Traineeprogramm mit klarem Entwicklungsplan und dem Ziel der Übernahme
  • Feste Mentoren, regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche, Zeit für Lernen im Arbeitsalltag
  • Moderner Stack: TypeScript, React mit Next.js (App Router) oder Vue mit Nuxt 3
  • Code Reviews als Standard, Tests als Standard, keine Bastellösungen
  • KI-gestützte Entwicklung als Normalfall, nicht als Experiment: Wir arbeiten intensiv mit KI, und du lernst von Anfang an, damit sauber und kritisch umzugehen
 
Dein Alltag 
 
  • Du entwickelst Komponenten und Interfaces für die Websites, Shops und Applikationen unserer Kund:innen
  • Du wächst von einzelnen Komponenten zu ganzen Features
  • Du schreibst Tests und nimmst an Code Reviews teil, als Autor:in und als Reviewer:in
  • Du achtest auf Barrierefreiheit und Performance, weil beides zum Handwerk gehört
  • Du arbeitest im agilen Projektteam mit Backend, Design und Projektmanagement


Deine Skills

  • Solide HTML- und CSS-Kenntnisse und ein Gefühl dafür, wann Markup sauber ist
  • JavaScript-Grundlagen: du verstehst, was dein Code tut, nicht nur dass er läuft
  • Erste Berührung mit React oder Vue, egal ob aus Studium, Bootcamp, Umschulung oder eigenen Projekten
  • Neugier auf KI-Tools und die Bereitschaft, deren Ergebnisse zu hinterfragen statt blind zu übernehmen
  • Lust auf Feedback und die Fähigkeit, Fragen zu stellen, bevor du dich festfährst
  • Deutsch auf sehr gutem Niveau, Englisch zum Lesen von Doku
  • Formale Abschlüsse sind uns weniger wichtig als das, was du zeigen kannst. Ein GitHub-Profil, ein Nebenprojekt oder eine Bootcamp-Abschlussarbeit sagen mehr als ein Zeugnis.


Deine Benefits

  • Das Frontend bei BRANDUNG umfasst über 30 Entwickler:innen in mehreren Teams mit jeweils eigener Teamleitung. Für deine Fragen gibt es damit immer mehr als eine Ansprechperson.
  • Gemeinsam vor Ort, flexibel in der restlichen Woche. Mindestens zwei Tage pro Woche arbeiten wir gemeinsam im Berliner Office, die übrige Zeit teilst du dir selbst ein. Die Bürotage sind bewusst als gemeinsame Tage angelegt: Gerade in der Traineezeit lernst du im direkten Austausch deutlich schneller. Mittags kocht unser agentureigener Koch, jeden Tag frisch.
  • Qualität ist fester Bestandteil unseres Prozesses. Code Reviews, automatisierte Tests mit verbindlichen Coverage-Grenzen, statische Codeanalyse und Error Monitoring sind in jedem Projekt gesetzt. Du arbeitest von Beginn an nach diesen Standards, statt sie dir später aneignen zu müssen.
  • Wir entwickeln unsere KI-Werkzeuge selbst. Unser Code-Review-Agent und unsere Ticket-Automatisierung sind Eigenentwicklungen statt eingekaufter Tools. Wer daran mitarbeiten möchte, findet den Raum dafür, auch als Trainee.
  • Deine Entwicklung verläuft strukturiert. Neben dem Mentoring führst du regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche mit deiner Teamleitung: Standortbestimmung, Ziele, konkreter Bedarf. Hinzu kommt ein Frontend-Format, in dem Kolleg:innen ihre aktuelle Arbeit vorstellen. Anfangs als Zuhörer:in, später mit eigenen Beiträgen.


Kontaktinformationen

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und, falls vorhanden, einen Link zu Code oder Projekten. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Wir schauen uns jede Bewerbung persönlich an.

data.title: Principal AI/ML Scientist & Engineer
data.description:
We believe it takes great people to create a great product. That’s why our team lives our company values, and we hire based on them, too. Since 2010, Pipedrive has been on a mission to support sales and marketing teams with easy-to-use, powerful tools that make everyday work faster and easier. Today, our cloud-based software is trusted by over 100,000 companies and used in 179 countries. We have grown from a five-person team to a truly international company of over 850+ people, representing more than 50 nationalities, with ten offices distributed across Europe and the US. In 2020, Pipedrive received a majority investment from Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that invests exclusively in enterprise software, data and technology-enabled businesses, making Pipedrive the fifth unicorn from Estonia.


We are looking for a Principal AI/ML Scientist & Engineer to lead a growing team of Applied Scientists and AI/ML Engineers. This is a role for a pragmatic "Builder-Scientist" - a technical leader who possesses deep scientific rigor but is fundamentally driven by the iterative shipping of data products that customers fall in love with. You will lead the technical strategy for AI/ML-based solutions designed to extract value from both structured and unstructured data, bridging the gap between advanced research and production-grade systems. Your impact will be measured through technical leadership, leverage, and the real-world business outcomes you enable.
 

Your new adventure:
  • Lead and mentor a team of Applied Scientists and AI/ML Engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and scientific rigor
  • Lead the technical strategy for AI/ML-based solutions focused on extracting actionable value and insights from both structured CRM data and unstructured content
  • Build the intelligence within our AI-native CRM, including the design of autonomous agentic workflows and real-time reasoning engines that execute business actions safely at scale
  • Partner closely with the AI Platform team to drive the overarching strategy for large language model operations (LLMOps), ensuring infrastructure supports efficient experimentation and robust deployment

  • You are a deep scientist by training but a builder by choice; you prioritize shipping working, iterative solutions that solve real customer problems over chasing theoretical perfection

  • Excellent product sense and business awareness, with the ability to translate technical and scientific choices into tangible improvements for our users
  • Ability to lead through influence and technical authority, partnering with platform teams to influence strategy and raise the collective technical bar

data.title: Senior Product Manager - Savings & Investments
data.description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

Overview
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the development and scaling of Finom’s Savings & Investments proposition – starting with a MiFID-compliant fixed-yield product and expanding into simple, accessible investment tools for SMEs across Europe.
This is a high-impact role at the intersection of product, finance, and regulation – requiring someone who can think strategically, navigate operational and legal complexity, and build products that are both loved by users and technically sound.
You’ll be shaping a new product category at Finom and defining how tens of thousands of small business owners manage idle capital, earn interest, and access financial growth tools natively from their Finom account.

  • Define and drive the roadmap, working closely with cross-functional teams (Engineering, Legal, Treasury, Ops, Compliance, Marketing)
  • Design scalable, compliant product mechanics (funds flow, sub-ledgering, yield logic, fallback handling, plan caps)
  • Collaborate with external partners (MiFID broker, custodian, asset platforms) and lead technical + regulatory integration efforts
  • Monitor product performance (adoption, penetration, AUM growth, ARPU uplift) and continuously optimize for business impact
  • Translate user needs into intuitive UX together with the Design and Research teams
  • Contribute to positioning, internal FAQs, and go-to-market strategy

    • Who you are
  • You have 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in fintech, brokerage, or investment products
  • You’ve built or scaled regulated financial products – ideally involving payments, wallets, or asset-based products
  • You understand MiFID and financial licensing frameworks, or are comfortable ramping up fast
  • You’re comfortable with technical topics (fund flows, APIs, settlement structures) and can work closely with designers and engineers
  • You’re collaborative, detail-oriented, and capable of driving alignment across diverse stakeholders (legal, finance, engineering, partners)

    • Nice to have
  • Experience working with money market funds (MMFs), ETFs, or other investment instruments
  • Previous experience integrating with custodians, brokers, or banking-as-a-service platforms
  • Background in treasury, capital markets, or B2B financial products
  • Passion for empowering small businesses and making finance more accessible

data.description:

  • Arbeitsweise: Hohe Selbstständigkeit und Eigenverantwortung, strukturierte Priorisierung sowie ein souveränes Auftreten im direkten Austausch mit Kund:innen und IT-Verantwortlichen.

  • Feier mit uns bei gemeinsamen Team- sowie Company-Events.
  • Bei uns gibt es kostenfreie Getränke- und Obstversorgung im Office.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

Eckdaten zur Beschäftigung: Die Stelle umfasst 20 Stunden pro Woche und ist zunächst auf 12 Monate befristet. Eine Verlängerung der Zusammenarbeit ist möglich und wird angestrebt.

data.title: Private Equity „Intern to Analyst“-Programm (m/w/d) - Einstiegsperspektive im PE
data.description:
Standort: Start Hamburg · anschließend bei einem Portfoliounternehmen im DACH-Raum

Unser unternehmerisches „Intern to Analyst“-Programm bietet einen Einstieg ins Private Equity über die operative Seite, aufgebaut in drei Phasen mit dem klaren Ziel einer Festanstellung. Wir suchen unternehmerische Charaktere am Ende ihres Masterstudiums: Du startest bei CAPCELLENCE im Investmentteam in Hamburg, dann operativ in einem unserer Portfoliounternehmen, danach fest im Portfoliounternehmen, wenn du überzeugst. Die Übernahme ist das klare Ziel. Ein Start ist grundsätzlich zu jedem Quartalsstart ab Q1 2027 möglich.

Aufgaben

  • Phase A: 3 Monate Praktikum Hamburg (Intern Private Equity): Du arbeitest als vollwertiges Teammitglied an echten Deals mit (Due Diligence, Financial Modeling, Markt- und Unternehmensanalysen). Zudem sehr aktive Einbindung in der Portfoliosteuerung und Wertsteigerungsprojekten. Marktübliches Praktikumsgehalt.
  • Phase B: 3 Monate Praktikum Portfolio (Intern Portfolio Analyst): Du gehst operativ in eines unserer Plattform-unternehmen, zum Beispiel AUTOLIFT oder NARR, und arbeitest direkt mit dem C-Level zusammen. Du begleitest in Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung und dem Investmentteam vielseitige Veränderungsprojekten im Unternehmen. Marktübliches Praktikumsgehalt.
  • Phase C: Festanstellung Portfolio (Private Equity Portfolio Analyst): Bei guter Performance wirst du die Schnittstelle zwischen Investmentteam und Portfolio-Geschäftsführung, festangestellt im Portfoliounternehmen. Du schaffst aktiv Wert im Unternehmen und führst eigenständig als Teil der Geschäftsleitung Veränderungsprojekte, von Vertrieb über Einkauf, Produktion oder Finanzen. Du begleitest zudem aktiv die Akquisition- und Integrationsphase von Zukäufen. Marktübliches Einstiegsgehalt und Partizipation über Exitbonus beim Verkauf.

Qualifikation

Du stehst kurz vor dem Abschluss deines Masterstudiums und hast bereits in der Beratung und/oder auf der PE- bzw. Investmentseite gearbeitet. Diese Erfahrung setzen wir voraus. Vor allem aber suchen wir unternehmerische Charaktere mit ausgeprägtem Business Sense: Leute, die Zusammenhänge schnell erfassen, wirtschaftlich denken, Projekte managen können und Dinge selbst ins Laufen bringen. Dazu sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, sehr gutes Excel und die Bereitschaft, ab Phase 2 flexibel am Standort eines Portfoliounternehmens im DACH-Raum zu arbeiten.

Benefits

  • Über die Portfolio-Rolle bekommst du einen Einstieg ins Private Equity und lernst alle Seiten des Geschäfts kennen.
  • Du sammelst Erfahrung in den Operations eines Mittelständlers und behältst gleichzeitig den PE-Blick auf Wertsteigerung, KPIs und Exit – eine attraktive Kombination für eine zukünftige Karriere auf Investorenseite.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Investmentteam und dem C-Level der Portfoliounternehmen und umfangreiche Verantwortung von Anfang an.

CAPCELLENCE ist ein unabhängiger Hamburger Private-Equity-Investor. Seit über 20 Jahren investieren wir unser eigenes Geld und entwickeln etablierte Mittelständler aus der Old Economy (Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Industrie-Komponenten, Elektrotechnik und B2B-Services) weiter – immer mit starken Megatrends als Treiber.

  • Investmentkriterien: Umsatz über 15 Mio. € und EBITDA von 1 bis 5 Mio. €, Mehrheiten, Primary-Deal-Situationen (Nachfolge und Carve-outs), Hauptsitz in der DACH-Region. Für unsere Plattformen kaufen wir zudem aktiv zu.
  • Einsatzorte: Deine möglichen Einsatzorte sind unter anderem die NARR-Gruppe (maßgeschneiderte Kühlräume – 1h von Stuttgart) und die AUTOLIFT-Gruppe (Hebeanlagen für Schienenfahrzeuge – Salzburg). Der Einsatzort wird im Vorfeld gemeinsam abgestimmt.

data.title: Backend Engineer (m/w/d) - Founding Team
data.description:
About Zahln
Zahln, by Zysygy, is building Germany's zero-fee payment network. Merchants pay zero transaction fees. We route payments directly over SEPA Instant, bypassing Visa, Mastercard, and the entire card network chain. No hardware. No card reader. Just a phone. We are building the first company to combine a fully software-based merchant POS with a consumer super-app for everyday financial life: payments, transport, utilities, government services, all in one place. Think what UPI did for India. We are doing it for Germany, from the ground up, on banking rails.:

EXIST Funding
This role is open to Master's and PhD students or recent graduates (within 5 years) from German universities, eligible for EXIST Gründerstipendium funding.

Location
Remote within Germany. Open to students at any German university eligible for EXIST Gründerstipendium.

Language
English is the working language of the team. German is a plus but not required.

Tasks

**Role Overview
**You will join the core engineering team as a founding engineer. You will own the backend payment engine end to end: transaction flows, wallet management, SEPA Instant settlement, KYB/KYC integration, recurring mandates, refund logic, and the compliance export layer (DATEV, Kassenbuch, GoBD, fiskaltrust). On mobile, you will contribute to the React Native consumer and merchant apps alongside our mobile engineer. You will own what you build from development through deployment, monitoring, and production reliability. The architecture decisions you make in the first six months will run in production for years.

What you will do

  • Design and build the backend payment engine: transaction flows, wallet management, SEPA Instant settlement, offline payment authorization, and recurring mandate billing.
  • Own KYB/KYC integration and the compliance export layer: DATEV, Kassenbuch, GoBD, and fiskaltrust for KassenSichV.
  • Build REST APIs for financial-grade reliability and high-throughput transaction processing, including full R-transaction handling and reconciliation pipelines.
  • Contribute to the React Native consumer and merchant mobile apps alongside our mobile engineer.
  • Own the full lifecycle of what you build, from development through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • Integrate AI tooling into your development workflow as a matter of course: code generation, automated testing, and intelligent review.

Requirements

Who you are

  • Currently enrolled in a Master's or PhD program at a German university, or recently graduated within the last 5 years.
  • Solid backend engineering foundation. You have built systems that handle real data, you understand databases, APIs, and what happens when things fail.
  • You think carefully about data consistency and reliability. You have had to ask yourself what happens if this fails halfway through and actually worked out the answer.
  • You take ownership of what you build end-to-end, from writing the code to making sure it runs in production.
  • You can explain technical decisions clearly to people who are not engineers.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage risk. There is no playbook yet. You will help write it.
  • Our stack includes Go, Node.js, Python, React Native, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs over SEPA Instant rails. Experience with any of these is a plus. What matters more is that you pick up new tools fast and care about writing reliable, maintainable code.

Strong Bonus (not required)

  • If any of the following apply to you, you will hit the ground running faster than most:
  • You have meaningful hands-on experience building payment systems, fintech infrastructure, or financial APIs.
  • You have designed a ledger and understand double-entry bookkeeping, immutable transaction records, and why you never update a financial row.
  • You have solved the partial failure problem. Money left one wallet and did not arrive in the other. You know how to detect it, resolve it, and prevent it.
  • You understand idempotency at a design level. Your systems survive client retries, duplicate webhooks, and network drops without double-charging anyone.
  • You have built or reasoned about reconciliation: detecting discrepancies between your internal ledger and an external settlement file and resolving them reliably at scale.
  • You understand KYC and KYB state machines and what a regulator expects from your audit trail.

Benefits

Benefits

  • Be part of a founding team eligible for EXIST Gründerstipendium, a grant from the German government that funds you to build.
  • Flexible hours and fully remote within Germany.
  • Early-stage means something here. Small team, real ownership, no queue of 40 PRs ahead of yours.
  • The problems are genuinely hard. Distributed systems, financial consistency, payment rails, real money moving in real time. If you want to spend your next two years solving problems that actually require you to think, this is the right place.
  • The systems you build will not be thrown away after a demo. They will run in production, handle real transactions, and be used by real people. Your fingerprints stay on it.
  • You will work with people who left stable paths to build a faster, simpler way to move money in Germany. Less bureaucracy, more momentum. If that sounds like your kind of problem, you will fit right in.
  • For the right person who grows with the company, equity is a conversation we will have when the time is right.

data.title: Intern, Global Partnership
data.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN US

  • Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

  • Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

  • Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer.

YOUR IMPACT

You will join the Partnerships and Public Affairs team with one goal: multiply what the team can do. You will work on international and European development projects and join a wide range of initiatives - from growing our industrial partner network to preparing major grant applications. To get there, you will bring innovation into how we work and make decisions - notably by building AI-driven tools and workflows that sharpen how we manage partnerships, grants, and our supply chain, applied directly to live projects with Europe's leading industrial partners and public funding bodies.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Support public funding through grant applications: help draft and coordinate public funding proposals (IPCEI, Euratom, France 2030, German federal programs); German language skills are a strong asset here.

  • Work with technical teams: translate engineering inputs into compelling grant and partner documents, and keep both sides in sync.

  • Improve team processes with AI: design and deploy AI-powered workflows (meeting-notes pipelines, CRM enrichment, reporting automation, coding agents such as Cursor/Claude) to streamline how the Partnerships team operates.

  • Map the partner ecosystem: build and maintain an AI-assisted mapping of our industrial partners and prospects - capabilities, contracts, contacts, and funding relevance.

  • Prototype and ship: own small end-to-end projects that create leverage for the team, for example, helping build a trustful stream of communication with the other teams to ensure that the information cascades correctly.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Background in energy, engineering / STEM / Mathematics, and/or business.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools and a builder mindset.

  • Entrepreneurial track record welcome (side projects, start-up or founder experience).

  • Fluent English; German at C1 level is a very strong plus (grant work).

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at "L1" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

Gestalte die Zukunft digitaler Connectivity-Services und entwickle intelligente Orchestrierungs- und Automatisierungslösungen für komplexe Netzwerk-, Cloud- und Technologieumgebungen.

Deine Mission

Als Solution Architect Connectivity Orchestrierung & Automatisierung gestaltest du innovative End-to-End-Lösungen in anspruchsvollen Technologieprojekten und schaffst die technische Grundlage für Connectivity für automatisierte, skalierbare und hochverfügbare digitale Services.

Gemeinsam mit Expert:innen aus den Bereichen Netzwerk-Infrastruktur, Cloud, Security und IT Service Management konzipierst du skalierbare Lösungen, die Automatisierung, Resilienz und Effizienz in den Mittelpunkt stellen. Dabei begleitest du unsere Kund:innen von der strategischen Zielarchitektur bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung produktiver Plattformen.

Bei Accenture gestaltest du dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem du aufgehst – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel. Und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen.

Aufgaben

  • Entwickle moderne Connectivity-Architekturen
    Du konzipierst End-to-End-Lösungsarchitekturen und erstellst High-Level- sowie Low-Level-Designs für komplexe Orchestrierungs-, Automatisierungs- und Integrationsplattformen.
  • Treibe Automatisierung und Innovation voran.
    Du entwickelst Plattform- und API-Architekturen, förderst AI-First-Automatisierung über den gesamten Build- und Run-Lifecycle hinweg und gestaltest zukunftsfähige Betriebsmodelle für hochautomatisierte Umgebungen.
  • Übernimm Verantwortung für Integration und Sicherheit.
    Du verantwortest die technische Integration heterogener Systemlandschaften und stellst sicher, dass Security, Skalierbarkeit, Resilienz und Performance von Beginn an berücksichtigt werden.
  • Manage Stakeholder und liefere Mehrwert.
    Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kund:innen, Delivery-Teams und technischen Fachbereichen, moderierst Architekturentscheidungen und begleitest Transformationsprogramme bis zur produktiven Einführung.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im IT- oder technischen Umfeld sowie Erfahrung in Service-Workflow-Modellierung und Technologien wie JSON, XML, YAML, YANG, TOSCA oder OpenStack HEAT
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Solution Architect oder in einer vergleichbaren Architekturrolle mit Schwerpunkt auf OSS-, Service-Orchestrierungs-, Automatisierungs- oder Integrationsplattformen
  • Fundierte Telco-Expertise mit Erfahrung in OSS/BSS-Landschaften, Service Lifecycle Management, Network/Service Provisioning sowie relevanten Telekommunikations-Standards, Management-Protokollen und Technologien (z. B. TM Forum, ITU-T, ETSI, FCAPS, REST, SNMP, NetConf, IoT, eSIM, Public/Private 4G/5G, WAN, SD-WAN).
  • Tiefgehendes Know-how in Netzwerk-, Security- und API-Architekturen, einschließlich SASE, Zero Trust (ZTNA), DevSecOps und sicherem API-Design.
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-, NFV-, CNF- und Container-Plattformen wie Kubernetes, Docker, OpenStack oder VMware sowie modernen Engineering-Ansätzen wie IaC, AIOps, CI/CD-Prozesse und -Tools sowie Sovereign Cloud.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

Benefits

  • Ein flexibles Arbeitsmodell, bei dem du die Möglichkeit hast, mobil zu arbeiten und deine Arbeitszeit aktiv selbst zu gestalten
  • Zugriff auf umfassende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten zu den neusten Technologie- Trends sowie Soft Skills, damit du immer up-to-date bleibst
  • Diverse sowie gleichberechtigte Teammitglieder liegen uns sehr am Herzen und um den Team-Zusammenhalt zu stärken, fördern wir regelmäßig Events und Veranstaltungen für dich und dein Team
  • Ein attraktives und marktkonformes Vergütungspaket, welches du durch individuelle Zielerreichung selbst gestalten kannst
  • Weitere Benefits, die unserer Meinung nach zum Standard gehören, aber nicht vergessen werden sollten: Mitarbeitenden-Rabatte, die Möglichkeit ein Job-Rad zu Firmenkonditionen zu leasen, das Partizipieren an unserem Aktienprogramm, Versicherungs- und Altersvorsorge-Möglichkeiten und noch vieles mehr…

Die Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied

Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Großartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst. Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. Und mit einer Arbeitsweise, die sich an deinen Zielen orientiert. Wie du dich vernetzen, weiterbilden und persönlich wachsen willst, liegt bei dir. Es ist deine Karriere. Wir helfen dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie du es dir vorstellst.

data.description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

In our Professional and Financial Services Business unit, we bring everything we have learned in more than a decade of Applied AI, and use it to help our clients navigate a rapidly changing landscape.

We develop and embed AI solutions which help firms become more efficient, enhance customer experience, and find the commercial upside in uncertain markets. Within the constraints of a highly regulated industry, we see so much opportunity for meaningful innovation and are proud to set the gold-standard for marrying technical excellence with safe deployment.

About the role

Banking is entering a period of profound reinvention. Across retail, commercial and corporate banking, leaders are under pressure to improve productivity, modernise customer journeys, strengthen risk management, and turn AI from a series of pilots into enterprise-wide advantage.

Faculty is uniquely placed to help. We combine deep technical expertise in AI with hard-won experience delivering real transformation in complex, regulated environments. We work with senior leaders to move beyond experimentation, designing and deploying AI solutions that create measurable impact across front office, operations, risk, and control functions.

We’re looking for a Head of Banking to define and grow our presence in the sector. You will shape our go-to-market strategy, build enduring relationships with senior banking stakeholders, and lead the pursuit and delivery of some of the most ambitious AI transformation programmes in the market. This is an opportunity to build a distinctive banking practice inside a company with world-class technical depth, strong delivery credentials, and the ambition to set the standard for AI in financial services.

What you'll be doing

  • Leading complex AI transformation programmes for major banking clients, from strategy formation to AI software delivery

  • Building trusted, long-term relationships with C-suite banking leaders, acting as a trusted advisor on how AI can drive revenue growth, improve operational efficiency, strengthen risk management, and deepen customer loyalty

  • Generating sales and revenue for Faculty by shaping software design, compelling commercial pitches, and exciting demos that convey Faculty’s technical depth and delivery excellence

  • Elevating Faculty’s industry profile by articulating differentiated banking propositions and points of view through the media and in industry forums

  • Ensuring the successful delivery of a portfolio of high-quality client work across the sector by guiding multidisciplinary teams, maintaining executive confidence, and helping teams navigate ambiguity, pace, and complexity

  • Mentoring and developing colleagues through line management, helping to replicate and reinforce Faculty’s Principles and collegial culture

Who we're looking for

  • You bring deep knowledge of banking, having worked in industry - preference for corporate and business banking experience

  • You are passionate and enthusiastic about the way AI can deliver better outcomes for banking customers

  • You have a well-developed and distinct point of view on how banks should adopt AI, and how AI will impact the industry

  • You've led large, complex transformation programmes, ideally involving organisational change with data, technology, or AI, for a bank or as a consultant

  • You are commercially minded - excited about hitting commercial targets through shaping opportunities, winning work, growing accounts, and owning meaningful revenue responsibility

  • You are a compelling communicator who builds trust quickly with senior stakeholders and can explain complex technologies clearly

  • You are comfortable switching altitudes - from executive level to delivery to challenge constructively, unblock teams, and maintain quality

  • You have experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams, and you care about building an inclusive, intellectually rigorous culture

  • You bring relevant academic or professional grounding in finance, economics, or a related field

Our Interview Process

Talent Team Screen (40 mins)

Introduction Interview (40 mins)

Sector Interview with MD Applied AI and Professional and Financial Services Director (90 mins)

Executive Interview with Chief Commercial Officer (45 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

Some of our standout benefits:

  • Unlimited Annual Leave Policy

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Family-Friendly Flexibility & Flexible working

  • Sanctus Coaching

  • Hybrid Working

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

data.description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world’s leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is seeking a Conceptual Designer to join a newly forming creative hub in London covering UK and EMEA. We’re looking for a modern, multidisciplinary designer with a strong eye for art direction, who’s immersed in the design world and the latest trends. You’ll be the visual engine behind London’s studio, bringing bold, beautifully crafted ideas to life across brand campaigns, OOH, social media, and short-form content.

You're a designer who can set a creative vision, and then happily get on the tools to make it real. Comfortable working solo or in collaboration with writers, editors and production partners. You’ll ideally come from a creative agency, or in-house background, with a portfolio that clearly demonstrates your taste for design, art direction and passion for visual storytelling across all formats.

This role is based in our London office 3 times a week.

In this role, you will:

  • Conceive and develop original visual concepts for multi-channel campaigns — from OOH and social media to short-form video — ensuring each idea is tailored to the format, audience, and communication objective.

  • Own the visual direction of creative work from initial concept through to final execution, maintaining the integrity of the idea across production, iteration, and adaptation.

  • Partner closely with a Conceptual Copywriter to build an integrated creative hub in London, developing ideas together from the earliest stages of ideation.

  • Translate briefs, brand strategy, and cultural insight into visually compelling concepts that cut through in a crowded category — work that earns attention and drives results.

  • Bring a strong aesthetic sensibility and taste level to every project, setting a high bar for visual quality and pushing the work beyond the expected.

  • Present and defend creative concepts to stakeholders with clarity and confidence, articulating the thinking behind visual decisions and remaining open to feedback.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with video editors, campaign managers, and performance marketers to ensure creative concepts are both ambitious and executable within real-world constraints.

  • Contribute actively to concept sessions — bouncing ideas, building on others' thinking, and helping the wider team unlock stronger creative directions.

  • Leverage AI tools for rapid concept development, moodboarding, storyboarding, and visual exploration — using them resourcefully to do more with less, without compromising taste or craft.

  • Stay curious about emerging creative technologies, cultural trends, and visual storytelling formats, bringing fresh perspectives and references into the team's creative process.

Please apply if you are:

  • 5-7+ years into your creative career as a Designer or Art Director, with strong thinking, craft, and a portfolio that shows what you can do, rooted in campaign work and not purely product or UI design.

  • Deep knowledge of advertising formats and how visual ideas must be tailored — not just adapted — to work across OOH, social media, and short-form content.

  • Strong aesthetic sensibility and taste — you have a clear visual point of view and know how to push creative work further within them.

  • Proficiency in design tools such as Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite; experience with motion graphics or video editing is a strong plus.

  • A collaborative, ego-free mindset — you're a natural creative partner who gives and receives feedback constructively, understands that great work serves business and communication goals, and thrives in a cross-cultural team environment.

  • Confidence presenting and defending ideas — you can pitch a visual concept clearly to stakeholders and adapt it with grace when the brief evolves.

  • Curiosity about AI as a creative tool — you're open to using generative AI for ideation, moodboarding, and rapid concept exploration, with the taste and judgment to know when it enhances the work.

  • Experience with cinematography, film production, or motion design is a plus — an understanding of how visual ideas translate to moving image is valued.

Benefits and Perks:

  • 5 weeks of paid vacation

  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday

  • Private health & dental insurance

  • Income protection and life assurance

  • Pension plan contributions

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

  • Focus on mental health and well-being:

    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

    • Company-paid subscription to Headspace

    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

  • No meeting Fridays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid volunteer time

  • Focus on your career growth:

    • Development Dollars

    • Leadership development

    • Access to thousand of on-demand e-learnings

  • Travel Discounts

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • Employee Assistance Program - including 24/7 GP & free legal advice

  • Discounted gym membership

  • Bike2Work

  • Season ticket loan

  • Social events & Thursday happy hours

  • Free lunch 2 days per week

 

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

data.title: Senior Product Manager
data.description:
View our much better version of this job spec on our careers page: https://juro.notion.site/...

 

***

 

THE KEY BITS

 

  • Location: We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located and have long-term working rights in the UK.

  • Flexibility: We operate a choice-first work approach that lets you work fully remotely from Day One even if you’re near our London office hub.

  • Salary: We benchmarked £90,000 + equity at IC4 level in our progression framework for someone based in the UK. If you like the look of the role but the salary doesn’t match what you’re looking for, let us know in the application.

  • Interviews: 3 stages totalling around 3 hours over 2-3 weeks. See FAQ for detail.

  • Start date: As soon as you can start.

  • Reporting to: Keith Reid, Head of Product

  • More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers, our handbook or ask ----- anything.

 
 

HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

Juro has big ambitions: to become the go-to platform for agreeing and managing contracts globally. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

 

Signing a contract is the easy part. Everything before it (multiple parties, several legal documents, opposing interests, a redlining process most companies still run through email attachments) is where contracting actually gets hard.

That's the part of Juro you'll own. It's the most ambitious area of the product and the one with the most room to change how contracting feels for the people doing it day to day.

We're not handing you a blank page. There's a roadmap in place and a team ready to build it. We want you shipping against it while you're forming your own view of the problem, then tell us which parts of it were wrong.

Every PM at Juro is hired to make product bets that pay out. Great means that:

  1. the bets you own deliver real outcomes for customers quickly, and

  2. those outcomes show up in revenue.

What you're here to do:

  • Ship against the contract workflow roadmap in your first few weeks.

  • Get close to the problem rapidly. Talk to customers and prospects yourself. Form your own view of the jobs to be done rather than inheriting ours.

  • Take on AI review. It's a deep agentic system (evals, flows, failure modes) and "good redline" isn't a pass/fail, which is what makes it hard. It also spans your team and our Agentic team, so some of what you own won't sit neatly in one place.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design and GTM to turn all of that into something people actually enjoy using.

  • Measure whether any of it worked and be honest when it didn't. Iterate or pivot when necessary.

Six months in, success looks like customers telling us unprompted that contracting in Juro got a lot more delightful and reaching for it in places they used to reach for Word.

 

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

 
 

WHO WE LOOK FOR

 

Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

 

To succeed here:

Every Juror finds their balance across our four core principles — we hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day.

Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles.

On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

  • You've landed in a domain you knew nothing about and were making judgment calls within weeks. Ideally more than once.

  • You've owned something complex and multi-quarter from discovery through launch and iteration + were accountable when it slipped.

  • You've worked shoulder to shoulder with GTM and engineering through launches + have been the trusted go-to person for them in past companies.

  • You understand why evals matter and how agentic loops work.*

  • You run your own discovery. Customer calls, prospect calls, synthesising messy qualitative input into a clear view of what to build.

  • You've brought ideas unprompted and built them without waiting for permission. Something small shipped in days beats a perfect spec written in weeks.

  • BONUS #1: You've owned the quality of an agentic system in production.

  • BONUS #2: Legal tech or contracting experience.

*What we care about is that you will dig into how a system actually behaves when you need to: work out why a flow is producing rubbish, go back and forth with engineers until it isn't. You don't need to have done this full time.

This job likely isn’t for you if:

  • You need someone to teach you the domain before you can be useful.

  • You think of AI as something the engineers deal with.

  • You want a settled team and a clean remit. Our product org will change, and some of your scope will cut across other teams.

  • You'd want to spend your first quarter rewriting the roadmap before shipping any of it.

  • You'd rather run the process than talk to customers.

  • You've been managing PMs and want to carry on doing that. This is hands-on.

 
 

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

data.description:
Tessl is a fast-growing Series A startup based in London, founded by Guy Podjarny. We’ve raised over $100M from world-class investors including Index Ventures, Accel, GV, and Boldstart, and in 2025 we were ranked #2 in Sifted EU’s B2B SaaS Rising 100 and #20 in Sifted's AI 100.

At Tessl, we are building the context layer for AI coding agents, and a platform for AI-native software development. As an early member of the team, you’ll help shape how we build, scale and support a company operating at the edge of AI and software development.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Content ships fast across engineering, marketing, community, and DevRel. This role is the connective tissue that makes that possible: owning the comms calendar, publishing content, coordinating creative assets and social comms, moderating comments in channels like YouTube, and making sure content reaches the channels and communities where our audience is. This is a 6-month fixed-term contract (FTC).

This is an execution and coordination role, and a great entry point into B2B marketing at an AI-native company. It also includes building automations for this work using Tessl's own Dark Factory, with support from our GTM engineer, so repeatable production tasks get systemized rather than repeated by hand.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Content calendar & publishing workflow

  • Own the content calendar end to end and keep it current after every planning meeting

  • Coordinate the publishing pipeline: chase drafts, request design assets with adequate lead time, and hold authors accountable to deadlines

Publishing & distribution

  • Own the social media calendar and publish posts (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Reddit, Discord) using pre-generated copy and UTM links.

  • Publish videos to YouTube with pre-written descriptions and links; manage thumbnails and playlist placement.

  • Cross-post published content to branded third-party channels (Reddit, Hacker Noon, Dev.to) with canonical backlinks and UTM tracking, following the existing UTM taxonomy.

  • Build and maintain an automation that surfaces relevant developer community threads (Reddit, Hacker News) and drafts contextual posts back to published content, pushing them to Slack in real time so DevRel and community-trusted individuals can review and post under their own name, this role builds the surfacing and drafting mechanism.

  • Produce a monthly developer-community signal report (notable threads, questions, sentiment) for DevRel, Product, Marketing, and Sales, which will become an automated workflow feeding the same real-time Slack surfacing above.

Moderation & community response

  • Respond to comments and questions on social and YouTube (triage or use internal tooling)

  • Moderate comments across channels: remove spam/abuse, flag anything sensitive or reputationally risky before responding (auto-hide is enabled for malicious comments)

  • Pull noteworthy comments, questions, and feedback into Slack weekly, so the team sees what the audience is saying without reading every thread themselves

Cross-team production support

  • Pick up ad hoc marketing production requests (design briefs, YouTube channel merchandising, banner requests) so they don't fall to senior team members

  • Flag blockers and surface feedback across content, growth, and product marketing to keep the team aligned

Workflow automation

  • Identify manual, repeatable tasks in the production pipeline and build lightweight automations or Claude skills for them

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

  • Publishing runs on schedule with few follow-ups needed

  • Authors and stakeholders get consistent, visible accountability through one shared channel

  • Distribution reach (impressions, upvotes, referred traffic) grows month over month against a shared baseline

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must have:

  • Strong written English and good judgment on public tone, since comment moderation and response require calling the right register in public

  • Comfortable working across functions without a fixed lane; this role touches content and growth in the same week

  • Comfortable navigating LinkedIn, X, Reddit, and YouTube Studio day to day

  • Has used AI and can demonstrate a workflow or application you’ve built

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with Reddit/Hacker News community norms

  • Basic Notion/Linear fluency

  • Some comfort with no-code or lightweight scripting for internal tooling

No marketing strategy experience required, this is an entry-level role, well suited to an early-career marketer, a career switcher, or someone returning to work after a break.

SALARY AND BENEFITS

Office: Our brand new 10,000 sq. ft office is in the AI hub of Kings Cross, London. We have generous catering and regular social events such as team lunches, drinks, and more. We require all staff to be in our London HQ at least 3 days a week on our anchor days of Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.

Salary: We offer a competitive salary based on experience and skills, benchmarked against industry standards and appropriate for an entry-level/apprenticeship position.

Benefits: 25 days holiday, health insurance including dental and vision (extends to partners and dependents), and a company-matched pension. We also provide a commuting stipend for those who live outside London, and a Cycle to Work scheme.

APPLICATION PROCESS

  1. Introductory call

  2. Hiring manager deep dive

  3. Practical exercise (content/publishing task)

  4. Final conversation with the marketing team

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement. We care about talent, trajectory, and mindset, not just checkboxes.

data.description:
Tessl is a fast-growing Series A startup based in London, founded by Guy Podjarny. We’ve raised over $100M from world-class investors including Index Ventures, Accel, GV, and Boldstart, and in 2025 we were ranked #2 in Sifted EU’s B2B SaaS Rising 100 and #20 in Sifted's AI 100.

At Tessl, we are building the context layer for AI coding agents, and a platform for AI-native software development. As an early member of the team, you’ll help shape how we build, scale and support a company operating at the edge of AI and software development.

Overview of the role

We're hiring a Research Engineer to join our AI Research (AIR) team. You'll work on the components that make the outer loop real: how agent harnesses orchestrate model behaviour, how we evaluate what's actually working, how pipelines turn production traces into the next round of improvement, and how we diagnose the failure modes that matter to real users.

These aren't four separate workstreams — they're parts of one system, and we want people who see them that way.

We expect you to sit close to customers — joining calls, watching sessions, reading traces — and to let real workflows shape your research priorities. You'll have meaningful autonomy and the resources to run substantial experiments where the bar for success is shipped impact.

You'll report to our AI Research Lead, and collaborate closely with engineering, product, and design.

What we're looking for

We're explicitly building coverage across four skill areas. You don't need to be strong in all of them — but you should bring depth in at least one:

  • Agent harness and orchestration design — how tools, context, and control flow combine to make a useful agent.

  • Agentic eval methodology — task and repo-level evals, dataset curation, the craft of measuring what actually matters.

  • Outer-loop and pipeline thinking — feedback loops, training-data flywheels, bandit-style optimisation, anything that goes beyond a single agent session.

  • Failure-mode analysis — instrumenting agents, reading traces at volume, surfacing patterns engineering can act on.

Essential

  • 4+ years shipping AI/ML products in a startup or applied industry setting, with recent hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic systems.

  • Demonstrated depth in at least one of the four skill areas above.

  • Strong product and customer instincts: comfort joining customer calls, watching session recordings, and letting real workflows shape what you work on.

  • Sharp evaluation judgement: benchmarks where they exist, vibes and quick prototypes where they don't, and the taste to know which is appropriate.

  • Experience building datasets for evaluation or training, including the pipeline work that goes with it.

  • Deeply curious about agents and excited about reshaping how software is built.

Nice to have

  • A Masters or PhD in a relevant computational field.

  • Direct experience with coding agents or code-generation systems.

  • Background in RL, bandits, or other outer-loop optimisation frameworks applied to LLMs.

  • Experience building synthetic data, dataset infrastructure, or internal tooling that other engineers actually used.

  • A project you can show us (GitHub links welcome) and a thoughtful answer to "Why Tessl?"

What you'll do

No two weeks will look the same. A flavour:

  • Sit in on a customer session, understand how their agents are failing, design an eval that captures it, and drive a fix through to shipped improvement.

  • Close a piece of the outer loop end to end: production signal in, dataset out, eval scored, harness change shipped, metric moved.

  • Own a slice of our eval infrastructure: dataset curation, harness configuration, runner, analysis, and the comms back to engineering.

  • Prototype a new harness or context configuration and measure whether it actually moves the needle on real customer tasks.

  • Dig through pages of agent traces, build the tooling you need to make sense of them, and brief the team on what you found.

  • Partner with product and engineering on near-term shipping problems by bringing research rigour.

  • Pull a recent paper apart, work out what's actually transferable to our platform, and turn it into a concrete experiment.

You’ll be successful if…

In your first 3 months, you might have shipped a new eval suite for a real customer workflow, improved an agent harness based on trace analysis, or built a pipeline that turns production failures into reusable test cases.

Salary and benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience. Health insurance extending to partners and dependents, pension contributions, and the rest of what you'd expect.

Our office is a couple of minutes from King's Cross — pet friendly, with regular team lunches, drinks, and socials. We're hybrid, with Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday as the primary in-office days.

Application process

  • Intro call to understand "Why Tessl?" and to tell you a bit about us.

  • A call with our AI Research Lead to understand your ways of working and how you use agents.

  • A 4 hour technical take-home exercise extending our one-shot implementation.

  • A half-day on-site session including whiteboarding and hands-on activities.

  • Leadership chats with our Head of People, Head of Engineering and CEO.
